scope: Gemini inspection completion, provider failures, and failed-analysis recovery

sources.applied: Check candidate completion and prompt blocks before parsing JSON; exclude thought parts from the final inspection.
Stop Gemini model attempts and compact rescue after permanent request, authentication, permission, or missing-model errors.

findings: Parseable JSON could become a successful inspection despite an incomplete or blocked finish reason.
A prompt block could trigger additional model or compact-rescue requests.
Intermediate model notes could become inspection data.
Permanent Gemini 4xx errors could be retried and their raw diagnostic messages returned to customers.

limitations: Mocked provider tests do not prove live account access or inspection accuracy.
A completed response can still make incorrect visual claims; the real multi-photo benchmark remains required.
Existing structured and compact-rescue output budgets are unchanged; live multi-photo completion rates have not been measured.
Paid-hold release was tested with mocks. This does not establish a free-scan refund or a live billing change.
The temporary access deployment proposed earlier does not include this additional change.
